rationale: C24 is the most recent earlier executive order bearing the child’s exact distinctive title, indicating a recurring series that suspended the same class of statutory employment provisions. That identity of subject and operative function makes reuse of the prior order’s legal machinery plausible, even though the supplied excerpts omit the operative text. C10 and C06 are earlier members of the same apparent series and are weaker chiefly because they are more remote.
